summary: A lovely, bright and spacious second floor apartment, enjoying a good outlook over the ornamental gardens and pond, towards Morecambe Bay in the distance. Centrally heated. Energy Rating: C
description:
A one double bedroom second floor apartment, offering spacious and well-maintained accommodation in a popular part of the town. Easily accessible for nearby amenities, including the railway station and bus stop. With the benefit of gas fired central heating. Recently inistalled, fully fitted kitchen. Modern bathroom. Early inspection highly recommended.

Location Situated over the Hazelmere Bakery, opposite the ornamental gardens.

Services All mains services are connected to the property.
